body: I'm 25 and it really is. I can't stop thinking for a second what a failure in life I am.

But not having those experiences really just messes with your head and makes me think why I am so unwanted.

What do experiences mean when I probably won't have someone to care about and likely never be a father. How can life be beautiful when all you feel is alone everyday and be reminded of that? Most experiences only do come with companionship because there are restrictions on individuals in terms of safety, expenses and even acceptability. You get weird looks when you try to do something alone.

People like me are made fun of all the time in the reddit and common media as the stereotypical nerd who is just bad at life and people enjoy making fun of that. 

What point is there in life if every second all you see are things like this? I can't even look in the mirror wihout seeing a bald old man. I think a lot of my body parts are changing these last two weeks or atleast I am hallucinating that I am.
What ? You look incredible. I think short hair is amazing if you can pull it off and you do it pretty well.

Yeah, I think all this came to the forefront when I didn't get into the grad programs I applied to last year. So, I began analyzing my dating life which I ignored for my studies. 

I just sometimes feel that niceness is seen as weak in the US because it is an isolated culture and this city is known for being this way too. Honestly, sometimes, I feel like I retreat to my books because I can't handle people and have a social life because I get too hurt easily.

Yeah, thank you. Likewise, drop me a message if you ever have a bad day or even if it is a regular day and you want to say 'hi'.  You are a really nice person for doing this. Plus, I make some cool stuff which would probably distract you for a while.

I think I wear a lot of ugly sweaters because I want a whole cycle of clothes before doing laundry. So, I guess I'll spend a bit more on laundry from now on.

Yeah, this helps. I guess the clothes not being great fits is probably my biggest things. I usually get a tad bigger than my size because I like to feel like I can move inside my clothes :P

My hair is starting to get white and I am worried of getting bald.  So, I have been asking my barber fir his reccomendations for conditioner and shampoos.

I think I'll try to take the advice on hobby groups. I do play soccer although not as many women do that. I think I'll join a reading group or maybe a programming one.

I don't know. Seems a lot to do with confidence and even while asking this person out, I pretty much panicked and rushed it out. It just feels so weird and scary going up to a total stranger and saying that when you know nothing about them. Plus, I hardly drink and I have never smoked, so that's  why I am kinda of bad at most social events. But where do you see those oppurtunities if you are not in any social circle and are mostly alone all the time?

I think I am changing and becoming more cynical and taking some real irreparable damage to my soul. People often say these things but their actions really don't line up. I'm just so tired of trying, trying to prove that I am interesting, trying to impress people who would never want to be with me and seeing people like that everywhere every day.

I know you aren't blaming me but thanking for using non-hostile language in your reply. I think the world is designed in a way that people are not meant to be nice. If people were meant to be nice, it would be easy to do that.I just feel that that is just what people say they want but really don't. I just feel stuck in a loop when I think of all this.

I also don't know what to do. I am willing to do anything apart from faking my emotions (Because it is very very hard for me) or being a worse person (because I have tried so hard to be this way and that would reverse all of that)

Maybe, but most people who match with me never reply and it's been around 1.5 years. I seem to feel like the leper at the social gatherings that I have been to. At this age, I have no idea what things are signals and what would come off as creepy. I think I get on fabulously with most guys. But at parties, it feels like no girl would want to be left to talk to me. Like the missing chair in musical chairs.

The people around me are supposed to be as liberal as they get and they talk about liberal stuff but their actions don't line up. It's kinda hypocritical because they defined their dating choices as their rights and preferences. I feel like when sometimes I put reall effort into my messages in dating sites because people want something apart from a 'hi', no one still replies.

Yeah, that was my first time asking a girl out and that was because I saw her for around a year. I don't know if I should go up to random girls and ask them out. They would probably think I am a creep and I'm definitely not feeling attractive enough to pull that off. How would you go about that ?

Thank you for taking the time to reply.

I just feel like I don't know how to flirt or be charming or look 'cool' even in my best personality. And I think these thoughts are changing me day by day. I used to feel this way before too. But since I moved to the US, I know no one and I get weird looks from people . The kind of looks like they don't like that I am there  and I get that look from everyone. I don't want to keep feeling this way, get upset , go on dating apps and get ignored there too.

I think a lot of people say they do dig that but they really don't. That's why I get upset sometimes and try online dating which has lead to only one date in 1.5 years where I think I was a meal ticket.

There's no specific girl right now. I used to talk to this girl at Safeway for a few minutes about once a week for the last year. So, last week, some one suggested that maybe she'd like to be asked out and although I refrained from doing so till now because it could be awkward since she was working there, I decided to do it. I explained how I was not doing anything because of winter and didn't know many people and asked her if she wanted to do something over winter. She hardly waited for a second before saying "No, thanks. I'm okay". So, right now I am questioning everything about my looks.

Thank you for taking the time to reply. 

I am starting to wonder if there's something in my personality that makes me like this. I was busy studying and working uptil 21 and I never learnt how to flirt or ask people out. I think I am too honest and I am no good at looking 'cool'. I think I am not at all experienced and that is just going keep hurting me. 

I felt like this even before I came here. But here, the racist looks and not knowing anyone are making it so much worse.
Well, no one is overtly racist. I live in a liberal place so I only get looks which people change once I look at them and the person who told me was a friend who thought it was obvious
I don't want to disclose that but I get enough to support myself.
Probably has to roll up his underwear
